reviews.author: Sarah Peterson
reviews.text: I had my builder hire Doby's to install about 450 ft of water and sewer lines to the public taps. They came, offered a much more reasonable estimate than others, and kept to their quote once the work was completed. Of all the contractors dealt with during my build, they were the easiest and most honest. Steve, who I believe is the owner, was also very friendly and a pleasure to talk to. I'm so glad that I decided to go with Doby's!

reviews.author: janette Fisher
reviews.text: I'm very pleased with Doby's. They came out same day and had the problem fixed in no time. The young man was very pleasant and helpful. Reasonable price also. Will be sure to use them in the future.

reviews.author: David Belk
reviews.text: Excellent work. The guys came in and took out the old pressure tank and filter then put new ones in. Very quick and the work looks much better than what they removed. I appreciate professionalism!

reviews.author: Tracey Broome
reviews.text: Great company to deal with! A real person answers the phone every time I call, they make every effort to come out as quickly as possible, rates are fair, employees are professional and well trained! They have come to our rental cabin several times and have always been extremely helpful, very pleased overall

reviews.author: Jan Thompson
reviews.text: I highly recommend Doby’s Plumbing. They quickly responded to my call and scheduled the needed repair right away. Chris did a great job keeping me informed about the repair steps since I was out of town. Excellent customer service!

reviews.author: Becky Castillo
reviews.text: Called Doby’s plumbing after bring strung along by someone else. They were so kind and quick to schedule service and solve our problem. I felt like they were transparent and genuine in addressing all of concerns.

reviews.author: Scot Black
reviews.text: Response time was great! Can’t believe you got to me on the day I called and had the job completed the next day. Great work as well. Thank you!

reviews.author: Amy Denman
reviews.text: Honest. Dependable. Knowledgeable. We've had service from Doby's Plumbing come twice since 2022 to fix problems at our home. They have our 5-STAR review! Quick shout out to Manny Olvera... He did a wonderful job and was polite, courteous and very skilled. Thank you Doby's Plumbing for coming all the way over to "Valle Crucis" area! We do appreciate your help!

reviews.author: A Ormsby
reviews.text: Great business, and excellent work! We have used Doby’s several times as we fix up our mountain home. The guys who come out, are always so kind and thorough.

reviews.author: Matthew Stewart
reviews.text: I called Doby's Plumbing late on Friday October 5th and was surprised when someone answered the phone. I continued to be surprised when he offered to come out that night! I replied that wasn't necessary and we scheduled for a Saturday morning appointment. I learned on Saturday that the technician (Jared) who came out was the very same man who answered my call, I was impressed to say the least. Jared promptly diagnosed the issue and set out to make the necessary repair AND as importantly, repair the deficiencies that caused the well pump to fail. The service was amazing from start to finish and the price was fair. I now have a plumber that will take care of my well, my septic system and all my homes plumbing needs. If you're in need of any plumbing work call Doby's Plumbing, you will be glad you did!

reviews.author: Denise Smith
reviews.text: Quick response to get a repair done in my shower. I’ve used them several times now at my cabin. Always very responsive and professional..Thanks again Tim!

reviews.author: Barbara Shoemaker
reviews.text: We had Doby's come out to repair and rewire our well and stub up septic system after damage from Helene. They scheduled the work and came when promised. The 2 workers were very knowledgeable and friendly and had it all hooked up in a reasonable amount of time. They cleaned up everything after they finished. I would recommend Doby's for well and septic work. We have used them before and have not been disappointed.

reviews.author: Grant Seldomridge
reviews.text: Doby’s plumbing has been my go to for over 10 years. They have fixed pipes and drain lines at my house and Business. They answer the phone, show up when they say they will. Friendly and knowledgeable staff. I highly recommend you call them for any of your plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Kent Walker
reviews.text: Steve and the crew at Doby's saved the day! Well, actually they saved the night, making it even more impressive. We had a septic backup flooding the basement after standard business hours. Within hours, the Doby's crew had pumped the tank, rotorootered the clogged line, and sealed the vent that had allowed the leak into the basement! 10/10 would hire again!!!

reviews.author: Lee Mawyer
reviews.text: Wow. I called at 1:25pm, spoke to the receptionist about my concern (main shut off valve) and asked for a ball park figure of the cost knowing they won’t know exactly what’s needed until they got here. She had to put me on hold to get someone who could get that figure, and after a moment picked back up and asked to call me back since she didn’t want me waiting on hold for too long. The entire call was ~3 mins (it’s relevant, trust me) and at 1:33 I got a call back from a technician. He had me text a picture of the valve and we talked about the different circumstances regarding my concern. At 1:54 he calls back telling me another tech who was in our area would stop by shortly. It’s 2:37, I’m finishing up this review because their tech got here, looked at the valve, tested it out and put my concerns to rest. Less than an hour from contacting them and my problem is resolved. That’s ridiculous. I’ll include a picture of the valve for reference of my concerns, but I’ve been waiting a week to get in touch (5 calls, 2 voicemails) with another plumbing company so you can imagine I’m pretty thrilled this is done.

reviews.author: john bullock
reviews.text: : EDIT : Upgraded from three to four stars when, as offered in their reply on this review, Doby’s made good on a previous failure by replacing hardware to repair a new issue with leaking double sinks in the kitchen without charge. This repair was made in early spring 2025 and continues to be effective. Much appreciated! Previous comment: Doby’s sent two foot-shuffling young jokers out who apparently jiggled the toilet handle to stop a leak on the toilet at my dad’s place. The picture is of the gasket they did NOT replace. The package is from the one I went to Lowe’s to purchase when the leak started again later the same day. On a previous visit for an unrelated matter, an older gentleman from Doby’s quickly and thoroughly executed a repair and then took the time to pray with my parents as my mom had a cancer fight going on at the time. So, you might get five star service with extra blessings, or you might get no star service. Reckon it depends on who gets assigned to your call. Ask for the praying gentlemen and not the jokers.

reviews.author: Jeffrey Thomas
reviews.text: I was impressed with Johnathan and Dave's work ethic and determination to resolve my plumbing issue. We were all surprised that the water had frozen from a metal coupling that turns 90 degrees and goes down into the ground at least a foot. It was especially surprising considering that the temperatures have been above freezing for the last few days. Each of these employees had good attitudes and exercised professionalism and kindness at each juncture. A very positive experience, especially with Johnathan although both guys are personable.

reviews.author: Lori Beth Horton
reviews.text: Always thankful for the incredible support and service for all my plumbing/water needs. Doby’s staff are always courteous and helpful, professional, dependable and capable. Totally trust and highly recommend this company. Unfortunately their prices seem to have doubled in the last three years, prepare for a wallet shock!

reviews.author: Fred Cerretti
reviews.text: I hired this company to install a propane tankless water heater about one month ago. When the water would not stay hot more than 2 minutes I called them to come back to look at the plumbing. I was told there would be a $225 service call fee if there is no plumbing issue. With this in mind I called Appalachian Energy to come back to be 100% sure it was a plumbing issue. The first issue they discovered is that Doby Plumbing installed a crossover valve which should only be used to when there is no dedicated recirculation line. But since I had a recirculation the crossover valve was mixing cold water with the hot water line! This solved part of the plumbing issue but there remained one more plumbing issue. After spending about two hours with Appalachian Energy they discovered that a backflow valve was defective and allowing cold water to mix in with the recirculation line. Appalachian Energy did not charge me anything for them to identify the 2 plumbing issues. Doby plumbing then came back to provide a temporary fix until the valve could be ordered. They turned off the recirculation pump in the tankless water heater and shut off the recirculation line as the temporary fix. When they came back to replace the faulty valve they forgot to turn the recirculation pump back on! They spent about 25 minutes between entering my house and leaving my house to replace the valve. Had they spent less than 1 minute checking that hot water was not coming from the recirculation line they would have realized that the recirculation pump needed to turned back on! I was charged a $225 service call plus tax and still have an issue! I had told the plumber multiple times to bring a bottle to test our water to possibly install a whole house filter. He never did bring the sample bottle which is now fine since I would never trust them to install a whole house filter. They lost my trust and confidence in their plumbing abilities.

reviews.author: Mark Goodman
reviews.text: Rich is a most professional plumber. You are lucky to have him in your employ. Thank you for a job exceptionally well done. Quick and efficient.

reviews.author: Amy Gentry
reviews.text: Gene is very knowledgeable, trustworthy completes amazing work. He and Caleb are very courteous, kind, and informative to their clients. Doby's clerical staff are very kind and easy to work with to ensure your service experience runs smoothly and scheduled in a timely manner. We appreciate Doby's for always being there when we need them!

reviews.author: Cory Dalton
reviews.text: My apartment manager (Hidden Creek) sent Steve out to take care of an advanced problem with my plumbing. He managed to clear a blockage over 50 feet from my toilet which likely cleared 2 if not 3 adjacent units from this significant issue. He was kind, professional and courteous, not to mention fast. I'm so happy my management company sent them out after I knew I couldn't handle the issue on my own. Nice to have functional plumbing after 48 hours. Doby's plumbing seems like they have it together. Thanks Steve!

reviews.author: Mike Jones
reviews.text: Had an emergency this morning around 8 am with a waterline break. CC allied Dolby’s Plumbing and they were here by afternoon. Person on the phone was super helpful and stayed in contact with me all day and was super nice. Plumbers arrived and had me up and going in a little over 20 minutes. Plumbers were great!! Highly recommend!!! Thanks so much!! I really appreciate you guys. You all have always been right there when needed. Night or Day!!! Thanks again!!!

reviews.author: Diane Currin
reviews.text: Rich and the coworker was very professional and very thorough. I would recommend Doby’s Plumbing to anyone who has plumbing issues! They also came out after 5 they had a long day and even had another job to go to after they finished our job!

reviews.author: Anne Morgan
reviews.text: As we are new to the Appalachians and this winter weather, didn't know what to expect was wrong. Dylan and Chris were quick to see the issue was that our wellhead had frozen. They defrosted it and put in some insulation. The cost for this work was very reasonable. Thank you so much Dylan and Chris for coming out so quickly to help us mountain newbies! Super groovy!!

reviews.author: Tonya Halsey
reviews.text: I do not feel he understood the issue I called about which was my garbage disposal draining into my dishwasher. He checked the sink and said there was nothing he could do about my actual problem. I was a charged $165.00 and still have the issue. Very disappointed in this company and will definitely use another company next time

reviews.author: Lisa Brinton
reviews.text: Absolutely outstanding. They were extremely timely. Worked with the inspector and my bank. Helped me when I was left hanging by the mobile home company and haven't had a bit of trouble with their work. Very professional,kind and treated me very well 3 years later, they are still outstanding service. There was not a filtration system on my trailer. They came today and cleaned my lines and are going to install that. Great service and there was no hidden fees. I highly recommend

reviews.author: Michelle Evans
reviews.text: Last night we had a septic emergency called the local septic company with their emergency number and was told we can’t come out until the next day there workers were working to many hours. My husband called all around the surrounding counties . Doby they answered they were so nice and understanding for a company that is not even in my town. They got the job done and I’m so grateful that the guys showed up even though it was 9pm. Being a cancer patient I need my bathroom. But I digress this is the company I’ll be using from now on. Very professional understanding and just super nice people. I highly recommend this company.

reviews.author: William Troiani
reviews.text: Manny showed up on time, explained what he was doing and left a long time customer with hot water. The only thing I helped him with was replacing the battery in his water temperature gauge meter, fortunately I had one available.

reviews.author: CJ nunnem
reviews.text: Victor and Jordan were awesome!!! Diagnosed the issue and got to work and had the water back on in my house within a couple of hours! My wife and I have three children and we have gone 4 days without water, so saying we were relieved when the water came out the faucet is an understatement. Thank you Dolby’s plumbing and thank you so much to the two guys you sent out to us!!

reviews.author: Ashlee Gilliam
reviews.text: Best communication I received from a plumbing company trying to get my water heater fixed when it went out. They were able to come out next day & fixed it for a reasonable price. Very nice & professional. I’m glad I’ve found them.

reviews.author: Deborah Donnelly
reviews.text: We took possession of a family home. This home had tenants that reported when they returned home on the 4th of July they had no running water. Thank goodness we found and reached Doby’s plumbing. One of their office staff answered our call and immediately put me at ease because we were at quite a distance from the house. (Out of state) They attempted to have someone respond that night however there were other emergencies. The next morning Ryan and Jordan responded, located the cause of problem, rectified it and provided us with possible future solutions. We were very pleased with their expertise and professionalism. Between the company and their staff earned a five star rating. It is comforting to know that if we need them they are there. Thank you Doby’s!!!

reviews.author: April Cook
reviews.text: Got to the mountains excited and ready for a relaxing weekend at my cabin but when I got there, I had no running water. They were at my house within an hour of my call and had my issue resolved within 20 minutes. Can’t say enough on how appreciative I am for such quick service! Thank you. A Cook

reviews.author: Joey Garner
reviews.text: I appreciate the crew that worked to find out our problem and seek to fix it (toilet and exhaust pipe in roof), but I would have appreciated it if they had communicated to my wife more frequently. they did not explain what they were troubleshooting so when my wife came upstairs, they had already pulled out the dryer and were addressing the concern with the exhaust pipe. They also did not did not itemize the bill they gave us. That is really surprising because I expected to see how much it cost to reset the toilet, repair the exhaust pipe as well as labor for their time. How do I know that Doby didn't charge me $50 for a clamp that only costs $5 at Lowe's? They did not explain anything to my wife, and then the elder technician went out to the vehicle to work up the bill, leaving the younger technician to clean up. Then he brings the bill in for my wife to sign and pay for without it being itemized and without really explaining what they did. I would appreciate a little more communication from your staff, and I expect any repairman or technician to treat my wife as a rightful owner of the home as much as I am.

reviews.author: Brian Finney
reviews.text: Well pump went bad on Easter Friday. I called and left a message and someone called back quickly and had a crew out and replaced my pump that morning. I highly recommend Doby’s Plumbing. Excellent service!

reviews.author: Chris K
reviews.text: Jared and his helper arrived at my recently purchased home within 3 hours of my "no water" call on a Saturday night at dusk as they had promised on the phone. They had my 3 foot deep punctured water supply line unearthed, diagnosed, and repaired within an hour and a half. The price was fair and the level of service was over the top. Nice work Doby's! 5 stars.

reviews.author: Emma Daves
reviews.text: I appreciated the women in the office who helped get the ball rolling on finishing the work up on my house. Emily was great to work with over the phone, easy to make payments with and they were communicative. I had dobys replace and update my water lines. There were several days scheduled where no technicians showed up. And then I’d get put back on the schedule for a week out or more. I did not have a functional toilet for almost three months. I was thankful that Steve (the owner) stepped in, helped finish up the work, and got the job done. It took much longer than anticipated, but the lines look good. I would work with them again with hopefully less hiccups. I do appreciate the help. Thank you!

reviews.author: Casey Ryan
reviews.text: Tim is the nicest and most informative guy ever! Very professional and courteous! I would recommend him and Doby’s to anyone

reviews.author: Peter McLean
reviews.text: The guys (sorry that I didn't get their names) went to the suspected source immediately and thoroughly verified the problem. They had the parts and installed them, and checked and rechecked that everything was working properly. I enjoyed talking to both of them and watching them work. Definitely a 5 star experience with these guys on a Saturday evening.

reviews.author: Brittany Stoudt
reviews.text: We needed a septic tank pumped out for a backed up toilet that wouldn't go down for our grandmother. They worked us in that day and arrived around 2pm. The employee, a Mr. Gore, was kind, professional and very determined to find the septic tank. It was hot outside but he persisted until he found the tank, the lid being about a foot and a half down. He was alone for most of the job but he was one of the most hard working young men I have met! We appreciated him and Doby's for being willing to take care of my grandmother on such short notice. The price was not bad for the work that was done and we even got a small discount for paying with cash! I would definitely use Doby's again for a septic pump and request Mr. Gore to do the job. He was amazing!

reviews.author: Madolyn Cearley
reviews.text: Had Doby's come out to pump our septic tank. The price was very reasonable, and the job done in an efficient and professional manner. We were very impressed with David and Ryan. They were proficient , polite and took pride in finishing the job well. Would readily recommend this company.

reviews.author: Anna Gonzalez
reviews.text: I've had a couple of plumbing issues recently. I called Doby's after not finding anyone available in my area. Both times they showed up the same day, did the work necessary and I didn't have to take out a second mortgage. The good experience starts when you call the office and talk to the caring staff. Great experience all around. Thanks for a job well done!

reviews.author: Donna Mcdonald
reviews.text: Thank you Doby for your fast response to our plumbing emergency on a Saturday evening. They called us back within an hour! Very impressed! We had two different areas of copper pipe leaks. They worked very efficiency! Very thankful!

reviews.author: Mountain Mouse
reviews.text: Jared, Victor and Chris came to my rescue on a holiday weekend (of course). 1st Jared talked me through turning off the well pump at the breaker to temporarily stop the leak. Then Chris and Victor fixed the leak and had the water back running in no time. The bill was reasonable too, specially considering the holiday!!! We will continue to use Doby's for all our plumbing needs!

reviews.author: Anne Dixon
reviews.text: Great service. I found Doby’s plumbing on a Facebook post when I was searching for a emergency plumber on a Saturday. I reached someone right away, they gave me a time range and then met me right on time. They were kind and courteous and fixed my leaking pipes and gave me advice for how to maintain my plumbing in the meantime to avoid further issues. Highly recommend. I wish I could find a handyman and electrician just like them!

reviews.author: Barbara Shoemaker
reviews.text: We had an electrical issue with our well pump and a tank bladder that had gone bad over time. Doby Plumbing came out immediately, gave us a price and did the repairs the same day. They are very friendly and professional and stand by their work. I will definitely use them again and I highly recommend their services.

reviews.author: Scott Sagman
reviews.text: Called around 7:00am on Saturday of the memorial day weekend. By 3:30 pm the new well pump was installed and we had water. This included removing and reinstalling a "simple hand pump"on the well. I am very pleased the the whole interaction.

reviews.author: Bob
reviews.text: Highly recommend Doby’s Plumbing for excellent customer service, knowledgeable and very capable staff. We had 2 line breaks and a shutoff valve in a culvert that was damaged by a truck and subsequently buried. We called on a Saturday around 11am and the guys were here in Foscoe in about an hour. They resurrected the shutoff valve so we could put in a new pvc pipe and cap, dug up and fixed the 2 leaks and in the process uncovered an unknown issue from old plumbing still connected to current water line above the shut off valve. Both Ron and Ryan did a fantastic job. We had minimal cleanup, maybe 30 minutes, given all the digging. My neighbor and I share this well line and we are extremely satisfied with the service, expertise and workmanship. Thanks again!

reviews.author: Chris Coy
reviews.text: This local company was honest, fast and friendly in handling our plumbing request and very reasonably priced. The quote they provided was exactly what was charged. They cleaned up their work area afterwards and assisted us with understanding some of the unique plumbing needs of a home with a septic and well system. We will definitely use again in the future and would recommend them to any of our friends and neighbors.

reviews.author: Van Cranford
reviews.text: Doby's came out to my house yesterday after my well pump was rendered useless by a lightening strike the previous night. My expectation was that I would have water back by Monday (this happened on a Thursday). Doby's came out the same day, replaced the pump and added all necessary insulation back to the well. They were professional and courteous the entire time. Will definitely be calling Doby's again for my plumbing and well needs!

reviews.author: Gary Marechek
reviews.text: Doby's plumbing rocks! Ronald came out today and replaced my water heater and did an outstanding job. Very thorough and professional. I highly recommend Doby's!

reviews.author: Jamey Widener-Reynolds
reviews.text: We had an emergency plumbing situation, and Doby's Plumbing called us back on a Saturday within a few minutes of us leaving a message for them. Jared, came out to our home about 15 minutes later and quickly observed the situation, got the parts, and fixed the issue. I thought the cost was on par the situation and what was done. They were the only plumber in the area that responded quickly when we called and did a great job. We'll definitely keep them on our speed dial the next time we need something done.

reviews.author: Emily Murphy
reviews.text: Doby's Plumbing employees went out of their way to accommodate. Dustin came and fixed all of my problems and was such a joy; so kind! I will definitely call Doby's Plumbing any time I need pluming or we'll work done! I wish I could give 10 stars.

reviews.author: Greg Butler
reviews.text: Replaced our water heater. The crew was fast, efficient, and professional. Have used Doby's for several other matters and have always been satisfied with the service.

reviews.author: Bill Poe
reviews.text: I wish to express my appreciation for the professional work done by Gene and Victor. They were extremely knowledgeable and kept us informed through the process. We scheduled an appointment with Doby’s Plumbing and Repair and they arrived on time. I highly recommend Doby’s Plumbing and Repair for all your plumbing, septic, and well needs. Thanks again to Gene and Victor.

reviews.author: Mona Childress
reviews.text: On time ànd excellent service. Explained what was needed and why in terms that was understandable. Very dependable and professional company. Highly recommend Dobys Plumbing.

reviews.author: Monica Moretti
reviews.text: After calling 8 plumbers around Beech Mtn for an emergency service with no calls back even if they advertise 24/7 service, I hired Doby plumbing through Home Advisor. They answered the phone (already big improvement compared to peers in the area), they followed up (another big plus) and they did come and service our home the next day. They were courteous, did a great job and have a reasonable price. If I could give them a 6 stars I would. Do not waste your time with other plumbers, call Doby!

reviews.author: Christmas Coldiron
reviews.text: We hav used Doby’s for our septic and for our pipe replacement in shower. They are quick, efficient, and very nice to deal with. From the office staff to the crew, this company is amazing!

reviews.author: Mike Doble
reviews.text: I have to say that as one of the point people with our neighborhood well needs, we have had to call on Doby Plumbing numerous times and as Murphy's Law would have it, it is always at an inopportune time. Regardless, Doby's has been fast in response, efficient in the work and more than fair in what they charge. I HIGHLY recommend. I have personally dealt with Jared on several occasions and he's awesome.

reviews.author: Kammy Silas
reviews.text: The ABSOLUTE BEST hands down in Ashe co. They were very quick to answer our call even though the lady told us that they were booked solid for the next few weeks. When we told them that we found what appeared to be oil in our well water she quickly shuffled a few things and got us scheduled for that afternoon. 2 hours later we had Ronald and his assistant here to locate the issue. After what was hours of digging, well past dark they were able to locate and pull our well. Due to our well being so old we opted to get a new one but we did have the option of them fixing the existing one. It was great to find a business like Dobys that did it all. The entire thing start to finish down to the grass seed and straw they put down before leaving the job. So grateful to Steven Doby and his team for all the hard work and long hours they put in (even had guys out here on a Sunday with temps never reaching over 7) in order to get our new well dug and us back into our home. I, for one, am a very happy customer that will be returning for any of my future needs.

reviews.author: Noah C
reviews.text: They didn’t have anyone available and had to put me on the emergency list. I called around and highcountry custom plumbing had someone available and close by so I went with them. But about an hour later I got a call back from dobys. They hustled to get someone available and ready to come out but I told them I already got someone else. Still I was impressed with their great customer service.

reviews.author: John Padgett
reviews.text: Doby was great; the lady I talked too on phone was fantastic and to get someone out around Christmas time was very helpful and professional. Will definitely refer people

reviews.author: Kevin Webb
reviews.text: Jared, and Jonathon showed up less than two hours after I called even though I'm on the Tennessee side of watauga county. They diagnosed my problem within minutes and had my well pump replaced, re-wired, filter changed, and pressure tank serviced in only a couple hours. Keep in mind this was a Saturday, and we had no water when we woke up. These guys were great, and I would highly recommend them to anyone. Those who are complaining about price should look into the cost of running a business, and appreciate that these guys are there 24/7.

reviews.author: sandra combs
reviews.text: normally i do not on a business but i feel like i need to this time. i have used this service for years. on 8/12/21 i had a water line to break under the bathroom. i called doby's which is a 24 hour service. no one answered so i left a message. the next morning i still had not heard from them so i called the company and was told they did received my message and i was put on the emergency list and they would call when someone was on the way. i called this company 3 times that day and the last time i spoke with someone i was told that someone should be out around 7:30 pm. still no one showed up. at 8 pm i tried calling again to a 24 hour business with no answer. needless to say i had to get a friend to fix the problem. so after being without water for 2 days i now have water again. a courtesy call would have greatly appreciated but i didn't even get that. plus i missed a day of work. not very good customer service. very disappointed.

reviews.author: Shelley Dawson
reviews.text: Doby's was the only company to call us back during a weekend well emergency. We had renters and needed to get our water up and running as quickly as we could. They offered late night service (which was declined after renters said they would wait until morning) even. They came in the morning and took care of it that day - We hopefully won't have another emergency, but if we do - we know who to call!

reviews.author: William Holman
reviews.text: They came out and were very detailed in the work to perform. All sounded great. And then we couldn’t get them to return our phone calls. We’d call and ask about when we’d be in the schedule. They always had a hard time finding our estimate. Then they always had to ask someone else and they call me back. They never called back.

reviews.author: Jim Capps
reviews.text: We had a semi-emergency leak under the kitchen sink. The folks at Doby's worked me into their already busy schedule. Jared was extremely nice and his work was quick and professional. I was really in a bind and they came through. Doby's Plumbing is now my first choice for future plumbing needs! Thanks again for being so helpful,

reviews.author: Thomas McNeely
reviews.text: Can't say enough about the customer service from Doby's plumbing. We had renters in our home in Blowing rock that reported a clogged shower drain. Simple task, not an emergency, but for a Airbnb renter and owner, it is an emergency. Called at 5:30 pm and they weren't sure if they could come by. I missed 3 calls from them at 6:15 saying they had a tech that could come by now, but I missed the call. When I called back and spoke to Chris, he completely understood my dilemma and guaranteed me they'd fix it in the morning. Both Chris and the other tech Chris had the issue resolved by 9am the next morning. In a world dealing with unhappy people and a shortage of labor, I was blown away. Will call on them every time going forward! Thanks Doby plumbing!

reviews.author: Linda Thompson
reviews.text: We have the most admiration for the excellent service we have gotten over the years from Doby's Plumbing. The plumbers are experts in the most current products that will resolve the issues that you have with your plumbing whether it is the water or septic system. The plumber explains the process with the utmost patience and courtesy. You will not be disappointed with their service.

reviews.author: Lynn Gelsinger
reviews.text: Dolbys plumbing was here the same day I called and fixed everything . Steve explained what he did and was very efficient, neat and tidy. A reasonable price as well!

reviews.author: Lucian Zelazny
reviews.text: Had an estimate on hot water heater replacement. This is the second time I have used Doby's for plumbing work. They are very professional and friendly.

reviews.author: Hope Griffis
reviews.text: I had some minor plumbing issues and Doby’s came out the day after I called and took care of everything perfectly. Very easy to work with and nice to know I can depend on them for any future needs.

reviews.author: Marcy Hubbard
reviews.text: I had to get a well line spilt and ran. Unfortunately I called another company first (in June) and had them do an estimate, I kept getting told that they were backed up with no water calls. Then I got curious and called Bobbi Higgins. Thank god I did. I called then at the beginning of September and they were out doing the work within 2 weeks! I can't say how thankful we are. Really great team too and they did a great job!

reviews.author: Kevin O'Connor
reviews.text: Honest and extremely service oriented. Steve, Shane, thank you so much for all your candor and service during the septic and well inspection. You being able to tell us what we were up against with the findings, what was needed to make it correct and providing us quotes for the services allowed us to see that this was not the home for us. Too many issues and a seller that would not acknowledge the issues, nor make the repairs to assure that what we were buying would not have huge headaches and potential cost down the line. If I can recommend one thing to people looking at property in Ashe County and especially up in Big Tree, it is get your well inspection first from Doby's. Then if it checks out, get the septic inspection. These before home inspection and certainly before appraisal. We would have save a bunch had we done so. Oh well, lesson learned. All my best to you guys and your crew.

reviews.author: Sara Faircloth
reviews.text: I called Dobys at 7:30pm on a Saturday night and was pleasantly surprised to find that someone answered and was willing to help. They were having a busy night so I expected that someone wouldn’t be able to come out until at least the next day. Around 9pm we got a call that they could head our way and I was shocked. We were so thankful that they were willing to come out and help even though it was a late night for them. The crew was friendly, experienced and eager to do the job! Highly recommend Dobys if you’re in the area.

reviews.author: jkh jkh
reviews.text: We highly recommend Doby Plumbing. We have an old mountain cabin that had a number of water issues, Chris and Chris came out on the scheduled time, found all of the problems, plus some more we didn’t know about, and fixed them all. They explained everything they were doing. They had to crawl into a very small space under our house. They did the job well and worked as a great team to get the job done. We will only use Doby and ask for the two Chrises in the future!

reviews.author: Aaron Bunting
reviews.text: Doby's is the go-to for plumbing. They go above and beyond every time. I was in Indianapolis and my mom had a severe leak in the pipes at home. I reached out to Doby's and within 2 hours, they had not only fixed the leak, but upgraded the pipes. Every employee is friendly and professional, completing every job with speed and precision. Whatever plumbing job you need done, these are the guys to call.

reviews.author: Chris Poole
reviews.text: Used them in August to pump our septic. First the guy ignored my directions of where the septic was and told me it wasn’t there. Then told me I would be charged extra to find the septic and extra to bring equipment out to. I assured him it was where I originally told him and that I would just call someone else. They tried very hard to pay several hundred more to find the tank. I finally convinced him to try wear I originally said and he immediately found the tank, of course at this point it’s pouring rain now. They finish up, give me my invoice and leave. Well when I originally chose this company there price was $50 more but the person I spoke with said it included seed and straw after they cover it so we chose to pay more than the competitor to not have to worry. Well they didn’t do it, I called to pay and told them they didn’t he apologized said he would get them to come back out that they must have forgotten. I was told to call back when they did, a week later nothing. Cashed again told this time he would adjust my bill and make sure I wasn’t charged and call me back, this happened a few more times. I gave up and have waited for them to call, now 2.5 months later they call telling me no they don’t do that even though multiple people on multiple occasions told me they did. Terrible communication terrible customer service they lie about what’s included so you choose them and don’t follow through. Never again will I use this company.

reviews.author: Jane Guinn
reviews.text: Incredible response, on a Saturday, no less. They stayed until the work was completed, it was a tough one, 2 other plumbers gave up, and when we were billed - it was incredibly fair. Thank you, Doby Plumbing. You will always be our 1st, and only, recommendation.

reviews.author: Magnatron
reviews.text: Don't bother. This has been the most amazing experience I've had in Ashe County. I have a water supply valve that is leaking, causing me to take a rental building off list, and the response I got for plumbing service is: "We can't help you for at LEAST a month." WHAT??? Plumbing service is a critical offering -- much more important to the customer than availability for new construction, and something that leads to bigger jobs down the road. With that simple answer, I wrote them off for any major work. If a plumbing company can't offer basic service work, they're useless to the community. So if you have water shooting out of the side of your house, your basement is flooding, your toilets don't work, you are apparently on your own. Wow.

reviews.author: Jennie Bare
reviews.text: Fast response and knowledgeable service. They pinpointed the problem, fixed quickly and honestly. They didn’t take advantage of me by telling me it was multiple issues, which there was a possibility of that and I would not have known the difference other than in my pocketbook. Thanks so much.

reviews.author: Brian Ellis
reviews.text: Jared is awesome! Plumbing came out on a Friday night with a great attitude and had us up and running pronto! I know he didn’t want to come out that late on a Friday but he did and had excellent customer service! Kudos to Jared!!!!

reviews.author: Gayle Murray
reviews.text: I have used them twice and they are always punctual & very professional. Today they explained how to change my water filter & questions about my humidifier. Great company.

reviews.author: Kim Templeton
reviews.text: The guys came in and corrected several issues in all three bathrooms! And completed in a very reasonable amount of time! Very happy to have all taken care of!

reviews.author: Janendal Carman
reviews.text: My tank was full and my whole house was backed up. They came out when I was told by every other company that it would be two weeks. These guys are amazing use them they make sure everything's ok and will come out that day if needed.

reviews.author: Monica Harless
reviews.text: Tim and Maney did an excellent job fixing our kitchen drain lines. Excellent customer service. Thank you.

reviews.author: David Powell
reviews.text: Doby's are the best. They are professional, knowledgeable, and efficient. My problem was diagnosed and repaired in a prompt manner. A pleasure to watch them work.

reviews.author: Christophe Dillard
reviews.text: Won't come back to do another job til I pay off a $1200 job from a week ago. They told me for a week I was on the emergency list, then can't come to I pay. I will never recommend them. The guys do great work, but the office will screw you over to make money!

reviews.author: Gerry Patterson
reviews.text: Returned our call within minutes. Saved the day, was having company and had no water.They came out and fixed the problem that day! Randell and Eric were polite and professional. Highly recommend !

reviews.author: Loyd Tyler
reviews.text: Doby's did an awesome job replacing all the water lines in my home. On time, clean, and took care of everything professionally. Will definitely use them again.

reviews.author: Sara Crouch
reviews.text: Doby’s has saved the day twice for us. Once on the 4th of July and then once more shortly after when the problem came back up. The second visit was on a Saturday and they fixed the issue for free. Definitely recommend them!

reviews.author: Marc Kadyk
reviews.text: The response was “above and beyond” my expectations. I realize what acting on an apparent emergency can entail, after having been an orthopaedic surgeon in Boone from 1977-2009!

reviews.author: Douglas Phillips
reviews.text: I was so impressed by Doby’s Plumbing, coming out to fix my house Filter leak,that I’m having them come back and do some upgrades! I have company that is visiting from England,so their timing couldn’t have been better!

reviews.author: Cynthia Bonsall
reviews.text: Doby plumbing is great. Timely and professional. I have used them twice and so pleased with their work

reviews.author: Brigid Q Morgan
reviews.text: I always have great results with the Doby crew. They arrive on time, access the plumbing concerns and then take care of it. Thank you.

reviews.author: Darin Lott
reviews.text: Great service, if there is ever a problem, Doby's is right out to help. They also always seem to go the extra mile to make sure you are happy with the service.

reviews.author: Brenda Councill
reviews.text: EXCELLENT! Reliable and Honest! Best in the Boone Blowing Rock Area. Never found another Plumber so reliable and have lived here 20 years!

reviews.author: Aurelia Leonard
reviews.text: Doby's Plumbing crew did a great job! We appreciate them coming out in such a timely manner and solved the problem quickly.

reviews.author: Eldridge Cleaver
reviews.text: These guys were prompt, competent, and communicated well from first call through completion of the job. I grew up in Ashe County (Google name is bogus, but I am a 8th generation Ashe County person) and these folks are putting at least some of the locals to shame. Don't hesitate to use them.

reviews.author: Julie T
reviews.text: Ronald came late at night to fix a cut well line. He had incredible knowledge and fixed it right, right away. Reasonable cost. Great experience with a great plumber.

reviews.author: Lyn Hunter
reviews.text: Quick to respond and very professional. Kept me informed all during work and cleaned up after. Great company and I highly recommend.

reviews.author: Cynthia Robinson
reviews.text: Great work today by Tim and Nick. Tim handled a very difficult plumbing situation with skill and professionalism. Thanks for your efforts and successful results.

reviews.author: James Sclafani
reviews.text: Ronald and Chris were great! Very professional Quick thinking to make the right fixes Took care of all our needs Thank You !!!

reviews.author: William Mortensen
reviews.text: Work performed was on time, within budget, and expertly performed. Highly recommend their services. 5 start performance

reviews.author: Harry Dillard
reviews.text: No water from well. Almost immediate emergency night service call. Immediately diagnosed problem and provided repair. Nothing causes more anxieties to turn on facet and have nothing happen.

reviews.author: Foscoe Rentals
reviews.text: Great to work with. Responsive and receptionist was awesome. They worked an emergency in for us on Friday.

reviews.author: Candice Cook
reviews.text: Very professional. On time, easy to communicate with and got the job done! I will call them again if I ever need a plumber.

reviews.author: Lauree' Jolly
reviews.text: Tim and Nick were prompt, courteous, and competent in completing our repair. Thanks, Tim and Nick, and Doby's Plumbing!

reviews.author: D Wheeler
reviews.text: Great guys. Identified the problem, came up with a solution, and solved my problem. Thanks for the effort.

reviews.author: Kathy Rhymer
reviews.text: Very courteous and did the job very well. Very knowledgeable about the job and informed us of our next step in the process.

reviews.author: Kara Pommier
reviews.text: Wow! Amazing response time and quick repair of my hot water tank. I will always use them for future plumbing needs and highly recommend them!

reviews.author: Jennifer Brown
reviews.text: We found a leak near our water meter and they could only get the part through the city of Jefferson. These guys went above what they needed to do and fixed the leak. These guys are awesome!

reviews.author: Harrison Graves
reviews.text: Excellent in every respect- communicated well, came when scheduled, work was wonderful-highly recommend!

reviews.author: Royce Moran
reviews.text: Very efficient, courteous, solved the problem quickly. Price was very reasonable. Highly recommend Dolby’s Plumbing. Thanks, guys.

reviews.author: Jeff Stafford
reviews.text: Couldn't be happier. I called with a problem and as busy as they were they were able to respond and resolve without hesitation.

reviews.author: Charles Bunting
reviews.text: Both times that I used them were rather urgent. They were prompt, did quality work and their prices were reasonable.

reviews.author: Doug Blaszczak
reviews.text: Polite, clearly described work and what needed to be done in detail, and very professional. Would recommend and will use going forward.

reviews.author: Griffin C Anderson
reviews.text: Great, friendly, and professional service- came out quickly on a weekend to help with a well pump replacement.

reviews.author: Sam Biglari
reviews.text: If you need any Well related work and you want It done right the first time, then call Doby’s. Emily does the scheduling, she is great and Extremely professional. Jonathan with Patrick are excellent plumbers. First class company with very fair pricing. Service is absolutely fantastic. Highly recommend.
